message.ltwairtransport.seat_parked: Seats work once the ship is flying. Sit in the Captain's Chair to take off.
message.ltwairtransport.two_panels: This ship has two Control Panels - a ship can only have one.
message.ltwairtransport.too_big: This ship is over %s blocks. Is it touching the ground? Build ships on Landing Pads.
message.ltwairtransport.open_water: Can't take off: the water at %s, %s, %s around your kelp or seagrass isn't a closed tank. Wall it in with ship blocks on the sides and bottom (the top can stay open), or move the plants out of open water.
message.ltwairtransport.no_panel: No Ship Control Panel is connected to this build.
message.ltwairtransport.no_envelope: The ship needs Balloon Envelopes to fly.
message.ltwairtransport.no_burner: The ship needs a Balloon Burner to heat the balloon.
message.ltwairtransport.no_fuel: No fuel! Put coal, charcoal, wood or dried kelp in a burner or in a chest on the ship.
message.ltwairtransport.too_heavy: Too heavy: the balloon can lift %s but the ship weighs %s. Add envelopes or burners.
message.ltwairtransport.already_there: The ship is already at that pad.
message.ltwairtransport.boarded: All aboard! W/S move, A/D turn, Space up, Sprint down, H for controls.
message.ltwairtransport.landing_blocked: Can't land here: something is in the way.
message.ltwairtransport.land_to_use: Land the ship to use that.
message.ltwairtransport.tracker_unlinked: Right-click a Ship Control Panel to link this tracker.
message.ltwairtransport.tracker_unknown: No signal from that ship yet.
tooltip.ltwairtransport.tracker_hint: Right-click a Ship Control Panel to link
tooltip.ltwairtransport.harvester: In flight: picks ripe crops and cuts kelp, sugar cane, bamboo and cactus next to it into a chest next to it
tooltip.ltwairtransport.kelp_dryer: In flight: turns 9 kelp in a chest next to it into a dried kelp block
screen.ltwairtransport.pad_name_hint: Ships can fly here from any Control Panel
screen.ltwairtransport.no_pads: No landing pads yet. Place a Pad Beacon at each base.
screen.ltwairtransport.route_hint: Press + next to pads to build a route. The ship flies it on its own and waits at each stop.
screen.ltwairtransport.parked_hint: Parked. Pick a pad or start the route to take off.
screen.ltwairtransport.burner_hint: Any furnace fuel. Burns only in flight.
